title: An Act allowing 'print free' digital legal notices for the town of Wayland

abstracts.abstract: By Representative Linsky of Natick and Senator Eldridge, a joint petition (accompanied by bill, House, No. 5486) of David Paul Linsky (by vote of the town) for legislation to authorize print free digital legal notices in the town of Wayland.  Municipalities and Regional Government.  [Local Approval Received.]
